items.title: James Hunter interviewed by Monk Rowe, Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: I remember when we worked with Allen Toussaint he was quite what do you call it, impressed that I’d even heard of them

ctx.x: Well some things are sort of the same across the pond. Who are your musical heroes?

Well when I was a teenager it was I think Eddie Cochran and Gene Vincent I got into. From them into Ray Charles, or that might have been simultaneous. And then I went more sort of underground and discovered the Five Royales and that was, I remember when we worked with Allen Toussaint he was quite what do you call it, impressed that I’d even heard of them because he said that back in the day it was only really ultra-hip black people had heard of the Five Royales. They were a regional phenomenon. They weren’t a…
Were you a guy, when you were young went to the record stores.
